description: Find the EU/international parent company for a Czech IČO. Looks up the company name in ARES, then searches GLEIF (Global LEI Foundation) for a matching LEI-registered entity. Returns LEI, name, country, and confidence level (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW). Note: GLEIF covers mid/large international firms; SMEs without an LEI will not be found. Pro Compliance tier or higher.
name: get_eu_parent
